programs.description: A poor couple who work in a brick manufacturing company struggles to provide their child with a new uniform as it becomes necessary before he gives a speech in front of a minister.
An elderly teacher relocates to Vaitagwadi, a village of uninterested and idle people. He hopes to reopen the school and educate the village folk but faces many obstacles.
Dinkarrao Joshi leads a lonely life after his children move out of his house. However, to help him keep loneliness at bay, his grandchildren decide to find themselves a new grandmother.
A man sets out to find his missing son so that his family can be complete. However, in his absence, his daughter-in-law and his grandchildren get separated from each other.
Changu and Mangu, brothers from a rich family, discover that Changu has a twin brother living in South India. A series of mishaps ensue due to mistaken identities.
Gautam and Gauri, an ambitious couple, are happily married and decide to focus on their careers. However, an unplanned pregnancy causes conflict between them and their families.
